author: Marc4360
body: Pale Dragon will always be around, get your tier appropriate class first. PD isn't that good anyway, it's mostly a defensive PvP pet.  Also make sure you get yourself T5 Kerberos pet before the month is over, you will want it's alignment buff if you ever plan on doing endless later on.
